test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 09 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a spelling error.

When the famous businessman / faced a huge loss / in his business, / no one expressed simpathy.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the spelling error in the word "**simpathy**."
 
• The correct spelling of the word should be "**sympathy**."
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When the famous businessman faced a huge loss in his business, no one expressed **sympathy**."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **1: "When the famous businessman," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any spelling errors.
 
• **3: "in his business,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any spelling errors.
 
• **4: "faced a huge loss,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not contain any spelling errors.
